Balamani is determined to see her son train under elite coach Christopher (Ronit Roy) and become a Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) champion.Liger fights his way through the national ranks, but his absolute focus gets heavily derailed by a rocky, turbulent romance with a wealthy social media influencer named Tanya (Ananya Panday).
